line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

decision: R1422: retain the shared __cdecl declaration. An explicit __cdecl local redeclaration would duplicate the ABI at the same diff size. Both drive error callers use the worker entry.

verification.method: Read actual current WOW and worker object symbols using dumpbin. Recompiled byte-identical pinned wdos.c in an isolated directory with product WOW flags and current headers, then inspected its undefined symbol.
verification.scope: Object ABI comparison; no new runtime claim.
